confidence_policy: Do not transfer or recalibrate baseline scores. New proposals require new independent review.
comparison_policy: Development regression only; source/control/candidate identities and membership preserved. Proposal suppression is not measured precision and cannot establish recall.
uncertainty_policy: Partial coverage, unsupported formats, historical schema/venue/plan authority, dividend baselines, first disclosure, public timing and final action identity remain unresolved without evidence.
ownership_policy: Reuse frozen ownership parser; no expanded schema authority.
changes: Inert narrative rendering with structural context exclusion
Sentence evidence retains negation and adjacent declaration dates
Do not create independent Item4 events from supporting exhibits
Distinguish common shareholder dividend declarations from investment, preferred and employee contexts
Distinguish approvals, renewal uncertainty and actual repurchases
Preserve filer role without guessing transaction parent
Consolidate exact or specifically dated documentary repeats; cross-document links remain suggestions
